args.context: The overall goal is to compare AAPL, MSFT, and GOOGL as investments. Your specific task is to provide a macro assessment that will feed into this larger report. The macro assessment should be structured as follows: Macro Summary, Monetary Policy, Inflation & Growth, Liquidity & Credit, Yield Curve, Equity Risk Regime, and a Confidence Score (1-10).
args.task: Assess the macro regime and equity risk environment relevant to comparing AAPL, MSFT, and GOOGL head-to-head and producing a research report ranking them from best to worst investment today. Gather current readings on monetary policy, inflation, growth, liquidity, and the yield curve. Produce a structured output with sections: Macro Summary, Monetary Policy, Inflation & Growth, Liquidity & Credit, Yield Curve, Equity Risk Regime, and a Confidence Score (1-10). Focus on the macro signal, do not discuss individual company details.
